speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: How stand that form?
premises: Thisness-just Your form, Lord, power-juiced; by sequencelessness itself time-reckoning forcibly melted.
By mind-power, speech too, sense-wheels, pots outside — may I stand that form at once, unceasing.
inference: Thisness-form power-juiced; sequencelessness melts time; all instruments at once.
